_comment2: New multi-provider format (overrides legacy when present):
_comment3: Web search for the #SEARCH: protocol, OFF by default. Pick a backend to enable: duckduckgo/mojeek (keyless scraping, bot-detection prone), brave/tavily (need api_key), searxng (needs base_url):
_comment4: REPL input history, OFF by default. When true, interactive-mode inputs are saved to $XDG_STATE_HOME/comma/history (default ~/.local/state/comma/history, %APPDATA%\comma\history on Windows), owner-only (0600), so ↑ recalls them in the next session. Nothing is read or written while this is false:
_comment5: Auto-refine after a failed command in the REPL, ON by default. On a non-zero exit code comma sends the failed command, its exit code and a truncated summary of its output (real paths masked as {{HOME}}/{{USER}}/{{HOSTNAME}}) back to the model, then prints the corrected command — nothing is auto-executed. While true, command output is captured (no live streaming, stdout/stderr are not a TTY, so full-screen programs like vim/less will not work). Set false to run commands exactly as before: stdio inherited, output streams live:
